Marketing Data Analyst — Harbor Retail Group

About Harbor Retail Group
Harbor Retail Group operates a portfolio of consumer retail brands. The central data team
supports marketing, merchandising and finance with shared reporting and data models.

The role
We need a Marketing Data Analyst to consolidate campaign and channel reporting across the
brand portfolio, replacing a patchwork of spreadsheets with governed, scheduled models.

Key responsibilities
- Consolidate multi-channel campaign and spend reporting into one governed model.
- Define and maintain marketing data definitions so that two brands measure a metric the
  same way.
- Automate recurring reporting that is currently produced by hand each month.
- Work with brand marketing teams to make sure tracking and naming are consistent.
- Support ad-hoc analysis on channel performance and customer acquisition cost.

Essential experience
- Strong SQL and experience building reporting models.
- A track record of automating manual reporting processes.
- Experience working with marketing or campaign data.
- Ability to work with non-technical stakeholders across several teams.

Desirable
- Experience with a BI platform and its semantic layer.
- Familiarity with web analytics and tag management.
- Exposure to retail or multi-brand environments.

Location
Dublin, Ireland, with a flexible hybrid arrangement. Candidates who require an employment
permit for Ireland are welcome to apply and will be considered on the same basis as other
applicants.
